description: Config-driven browser flow descriptor for China Telecom Tianyi Cloud Drive login and current-session capture.
notes: This catalog reuses the same browser-flow and CDP stack used by the Unicom auth broker.
Telecom login controls live inside the cross-origin iframe named udb_login, so frame-aware browser-flow execution is required.
Do not store live phone numbers, SMS codes, Browser-Id values, Cookie headers, or other secrets in this file.

operations.source: (() => { const normalize = (value) => String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const findAgreementIcon = () => document.querySelector('#j-agreement-box-sms') || document.querySelector('#j-agreement-box'); const findAutoGroup = () => document.querySelector('#j-auto-group-sms') || document.querySelector('#j-auto-group'); const isIconChecked = (node) => node instanceof Element && (node.classList.contains('checkbox-icon2') || String(node.getAttribute('data-index') || '') === '1'); const ensureIconChecked = (node, label) => { if (!(node instanceof Element)) { throw new Error(label + ' control not available'); } if (isIconChecked(node)) { return { found: true, changed: false, checked: true, class_name: node.className || null, data_index: node.getAttribute('data-index') || null }; } node.click(); if (!isIconChecked(node)) { throw new Error(label + ' control did not become checked'); } return { found: true, changed: true, checked: true, class_name: node.className || null, data_index: node.getAttribute('data-index') || null }; }; const ensureThirtyDayAutoLogin = (group) => { if (!(group instanceof Element)) { throw new Error('30-day auto login group not available'); } const icon = group.querySelector('#j-auto-login-sms, #j-auto-login') || group.querySelector('.icon'); const iconState = ensureIconChecked(icon, '30-day auto login'); const timeText = group.querySelector('.login-time-text'); const option = group.querySelector('.login-option-list .option[data-time="3"]') || Array.from(group.querySelectorAll('.login-option-list .option')).find((candidate) => normalize(candidate?.innerText || candidate?.textContent || '') === '30天内自动登录'); if (!(option instanceof Element)) { throw new Error('30-day auto login option not available'); } const selectedBefore = option.classList.contains('active') && normalize(timeText?.innerText || timeText?.textContent || '') === '30天内自动登录'; if (!selectedBefore) { option.click(); } const selected = option.classList.contains('active') && normalize(timeText?.innerText || timeText?.textContent || '') === '30天内自动登录'; if (!selected) { throw new Error('30-day auto login option did not become active'); } return { found: true, changed: iconState.changed || !selectedBefore, checked: true, selected: true, current_text: normalize(timeText?.innerText || timeText?.textContent || ''), option_class_name: option.className || null }; }; const agreement = ensureIconChecked(findAgreementIcon(), 'sms agreement'); const autoLogin = ensureThirtyDayAutoLogin(findAutoGroup()); return { agreement, auto_login: autoLogin }; })()
notes: This operation is idempotent: if the Telecom SMS agreement is already checked, it leaves the page unchanged.
Telecom uses icon-based controls instead of native checkbox inputs, so this operation checks for the real checkbox-icon2 state on #j-agreement-box-sms and #j-auto-login-sms.
It also ensures the SMS-side auto-login duration is explicitly set to the 30-day option (data-time=3) rather than relying on a generic text/checkbox heuristic.

operations.source: (() => { const KEY = '__ccbgTelecomSendCodeState'; const BUTTON_SELECTOR = '#j-msg-verifyCode'; const SELECTORS = ['.toast', '.toast-msg', '.toast-message', '.van-toast', '.dialog-toast', '.message', '.msg', '.msg-tips', '.error', '.error-msg', '.warn', '.warning', '.notice', '.tip', '.form-error', '[role="alert"]', '[role="status"]']; const normalize = (value) => String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const isVisible = (node) => { if (!(node instanceof Element)) { return false; } const rect = typeof node.getBoundingClientRect === 'function' ? node.getBoundingClientRect() : { width: 0, height: 0 }; if (rect.width <= 0 || rect.height <= 0) { return false; } const style = typeof window.getComputedStyle === 'function' ? window.getComputedStyle(node) : null; return !style || (style.display !== 'none' && style.visibility !== 'hidden' && style.opacity !== '0'); }; const describeButton = () => { const button = document.querySelector(BUTTON_SELECTOR); if (!(button instanceof Element)) { return null; } const rect = button.getBoundingClientRect(); return { tag: button.tagName || null, class_name: button.className || null, text: normalize(button.innerText || button.textContent || ''), rect: { x: rect.x, y: rect.y, width: rect.width, height: rect.height } }; }; const looksRelevant = (text, node) => { if (!text || text.length > 120) { return false; } if (/(验证码|短信|频繁|稍后|失败|错误|异常|重新|安全|验证|滑块|登录)/.test(text)) { return true; } const cls = String(node?.className || '').toLowerCase(); const role = String(node?.getAttribute?.('role') || '').toLowerCase(); return /message|toast|notice|alert|error|warn|tip|dialog/.test(cls) || role === 'alert' || role === 'status'; }; const previous = window[KEY]; if (previous?.observer && typeof previous.observer.disconnect === 'function') { previous.observer.disconnect(); } if (previous?.poller) { window.clearInterval(previous.poller); } const state = { installed_at_unix_ms: Date.now(), before_text: normalize(document.querySelector(BUTTON_SELECTOR)?.innerText || document.querySelector(BUTTON_SELECTOR)?.textContent || ''), before_candidate: describeButton(), messages: [], last_message: '', last_source: '', last_seen_at_unix_ms: 0, observer: null, poller: null }; window[KEY] = state; const capture = (rawText, source, node) => { const text = normalize(rawText); if (!looksRelevant(text, node)) { return false; } const now = Date.now(); const last = state.messages[state.messages.length - 1]; if (last && last.text === text && now - last.seen_at_unix_ms < 1200) { state.last_seen_at_unix_ms = now; return false; } const entry = { text, source, seen_at_unix_ms: now }; state.messages.push(entry); if (state.messages.length > 12) { state.messages = state.messages.slice(-12); } state.last_message = text; state.last_source = source; state.last_seen_at_unix_ms = now; return true; }; const inspectNode = (node, source) => { if (!(node instanceof Element) || !isVisible(node)) { return false; } return capture(node.innerText || node.textContent || '', source, node); }; const scan = (root, source) => { const scope = root instanceof Element || root instanceof Document ? root : document; for (const selector of SELECTORS) { const nodes = scope.querySelectorAll ? Array.from(scope.querySelectorAll(selector)) : []; for (const node of nodes) { inspectNode(node, `${source}:${selector}`); } } }; if (document.body) { scan(document, 'install'); const observer = new MutationObserver((records) => { for (const record of records) { if (record.target instanceof Element) { inspectNode(record.target, 'mutation-target'); } for (const node of Array.from(record.addedNodes || [])) { if (node instanceof Element) { inspectNode(node, 'mutation-added'); scan(node, 'mutation-scan'); } } } }); observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true, characterData: true }); state.observer = observer; state.poller = window.setInterval(() => { if (Date.now() - state.installed_at_unix_ms > 15000) { if (state.observer && typeof state.observer.disconnect === 'function') { state.observer.disconnect(); } if (state.poller) { window.clearInterval(state.poller); state.poller = null; } return; } scan(document, 'poll'); }, 250); } return { installed: true, before_text: state.before_text, selector_count: SELECTORS.length }; })()
notes: Install a short-lived DOM observer before clicking the SMS send-code control so transient feedback can be captured into window.__ccbgTelecomSendCodeState.
This helps the assistant detect rate limiting or secondary verification prompts even when the page only flashes the message briefly.

operations.source: (() => { const KEY = '__ccbgTelecomUploadProbe'; const normalize = (value) => String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const isVisible = (node) => { if (!(node instanceof Element)) { return false; } const rect = node.getBoundingClientRect(); if (rect.width <= 0 || rect.height <= 0) { return false; } const style = window.getComputedStyle(node); return style.display !== 'none' && style.visibility !== 'hidden' && style.opacity !== '0'; }; const domPath = (node) => { if (!(node instanceof Element)) { return null; } const parts = []; let current = node; while (current && current instanceof Element && parts.length < 5) { let part = current.tagName.toLowerCase(); if (current.id) { part += `#${current.id}`; parts.unshift(part); break; } const cls = String(current.className || '').trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 2).join('.'); if (cls) { part += `.${cls}`; } parts.unshift(part); current = current.parentElement; } return parts.join(' > ') || null; }; const state = (window[KEY] && typeof window[KEY] === 'object') ? window[KEY] : { installed_at_unix_ms: Date.now(), events: [], surface_snapshots: [] }; window[KEY] = state; const uploadControls = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button,a,span,div,label,li')).filter(node => { if (!isVisible(node)) { return false; } const text = normalize(node.innerText || node.textContent || ''); const cls = `${node.className || ''}`.toLowerCase(); const title = normalize(node.getAttribute?.('title') || ''); const aria = normalize(node.getAttribute?.('aria-label') || ''); return /上传|添加|新建|文件|文件夹/.test(text) || /upload|file|folder|create|add/.test(`${text} ${title} ${aria}`.toLowerCase()) || /(upload|uploader|file-upload|upload-btn|file-btn|toolbar)/.test(cls); }).slice(0, 16).map(node => { const rect = node.getBoundingClientRect(); return { tag: node.tagName || null, text: normalize(node.innerText || node.textContent || '') || null, class_name: String(node.className || '') || null, dom_path: domPath(node), rect: { x: rect.x, y: rect.y, width: rect.width, height: rect.height } }; }); const fileInputs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("input[type='file']")).filter(node => node instanceof HTMLInputElement).slice(0, 12).map(node => { const rect = node.getBoundingClientRect(); return { visible: isVisible(node), disabled: !!node.disabled, multiple: !!node.multiple, accept: String(node.accept || '') || null, dom_path: domPath(node), rect: { x: rect.x, y: rect.y, width: rect.width, height: rect.height }, selected_file_count: node.files ? node.files.length : 0, selected_total_size_bytes: node.files ? Array.from(node.files).reduce((sum, file) => sum + Number(file?.size || 0), 0) : 0 }; }); const snapshot = { captured_at_unix_ms: Date.now(), url: location.href, title: document.title || null, upload_controls: uploadControls, file_inputs: fileInputs }; state.surface_snapshots = Array.isArray(state.surface_snapshots) ? state.surface_snapshots : []; state.surface_snapshots.push(snapshot); if (state.surface_snapshots.length > 8) { state.surface_snapshots = state.surface_snapshots.slice(-8); } return snapshot; })()
notes: Capture visible controls and mounted file inputs on the current Telecom page so write-path discovery does not depend on copying brittle DOM facts by hand.
